records.quote: Figure 5 displays the calculated activity of lithium in the solid phase at 850 K together with the experimental data obtained by Gąsior and Schwitzgebel [15]. As it can be found in the phase diagram (Fig. 1), at the temperature of 850 K, two phases exist: Liquid and InLi. The experimental data shown in Figure 4 exhibit the activity of Li in the solid InLi phase. One can see that the calculation fairly reproduces the experiment. A disagreement can be found between the experimental determination for the composition equalling 0.65 mole fraction of Li and the calculation. The experimental point indicates a single-phase region, whereas the calculation shows a binary (InLI + Liquid) region.
